thread:
Maya: Hey team — dropping the HelioSky partner asset pack. Need quick checks on logo colorways, customer quote usage, and the marketplace tile. Links: https://figma.com/file/xyz and https://s3.redwood-inference/heliosky-assets.zip

Noah: looked through the pack. Two primary logo variants: heliosky_full_light.png and heliosky_mark_dark.png. Suggest we add 16px clearspace around the mark for marketplace thumbnails. :eyes:

Harper: Quick commercial question — can we publish the customer quote 'Redwood cut inference costs by 60%' in the joint case tile? IO signed but not sure about explicit quote release. @Julia can you advise?

Julia: Short answer: we need explicit written approval for any customer-attributed quote. IO may cover logos but often not verbatim quotes. If HelioSky can provide an approval email or a signed quote release, we're good. Otherwise we should ship a quote-free version.

Eli: Also flag for product copy — avoid technical detail on the marketplace tile (e.g., 'quantized 4-bit model'). Keep messaging product-focused (latency, cost, reliability).

Noah: Design note — marketplace image sizes to prep: hero 1200x628, tile 300x300, banner 1024x256. I'll output PNG + WebP variants. Current swatches in Figma:```
Primary: #0057D9
Accent: #00C2A8
Neutral 900: #0F1724
Neutral 100: #F7FAFC
```

DesignBot: Preview render uploaded: https://cdn.redwood.design/previews/2234567890/heliosky-thumb.png

Maya: Nice. Harper — can you secure the quote sign-off by EOD? If not, we iterate with the quote-free tile and swap later. Also need confirmation on logo usage for dark backgrounds.

Harper: Messaging HelioSky contact Ana now. She says legal will try to confirm by tomorrow morning. :thumbsup: I'll paste the email approval here when received.

Julia: If they provide approval, we require three things: 1) copy of the approval email, 2) exact quote text to publish, 3) attribution line (customer name + role). Also confirm logo grant covers 'web + marketplace listing'.

Noah: Plan is to produce two drafts: (A) with quote and proper attribution, (B) without quote. I'll include alt-text and accessible color contrast notes in the Figma file.

Eli: Small QA ask — include a manifest.json in the asset zip with filenames and intended uses. Example snippet:
```json
{
  "hero": "helio_hero_1200x628.png",
  "thumbnail": "helio_thumb_300x300.png",
  "logo_light": "heliosky_full_light.png"
}
```

Maya: Perfect. Once design pushes finals, tag it ready-for-ops and I'll coordinate publishing with marketplace team.

Harper: Note to self — rename final archive to helio_co_marketing_candidate_v1.zip when we have clearance. Also reminder: do not use any third-party customer logos unless we have explicit permission.

Noah: Uploading drafts to the shared folder now. Will ping when both variants are in S3.

Maya: Thanks everyone. Keeping this thread open — will repost approval here when Ana responds. :sparkles:
